name: No access page
summary: A 403 page that says who owns the page and lets the person ask for access with an optional note, without blaming them.
use: when a signed-in person opens something they don't have permission to see
a11y: The note is a labelled text area; after the request is sent, the confirmation is a polite status that takes focus, so keyboard and screen-reader users hear it.

use_when: the person is signed in and the item exists, but they lack permission
a shared link points to a workspace they're not in
avoid_when: the item doesn't exist: use page-not-found (also when revealing that it exists would leak information)
the person is signed out: use session-expired or the sign-in page
keyboard: Tab reaches the note, Request access, then Switch account
After the request is sent, focus moves to the confirmation

empty.how: Not applicable: this state screen shows no list of records.

loading.how: Not applicable: shown instead of content, after loading has failed or been refused.

error.how: The part is itself an error or system state, written in plain words with a next step.

disabled.how: No control here is ever disabled; each one always does something.

overflow.how: Actions stack full width under 30rem; the panel caps its width.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

missing_image.how: The part has no picture; its drawing is an inline icon.
